resources.string: ScrollStop looks at the screen of Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Snapchat, TikTok, web browsers and any app you put a limit on, only to detect when a Reels, Shorts or Spotlight screen opens. It then presses Back, covers the tab button, or shows a reminder. When strict mode is on it also stops ScrollStop from being switched off or uninstalled. To make the cover over a tab button match the app\'s colours it reads a few pixels from one screenshot, which is thrown away right after. Nothing it sees is stored or sent anywhere.
Today\'s social time, and quick ways into Instagram and YouTube without the feeds
